projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial eastern South Pacific103–88W reach near historical STF-crossing context. Historical P18/P19 fronts were observed in different years; they do not establish one simultaneous velocity axis. Exclude western basin/Chatham Rise, ACC export branches, Chile-Peru coastal flow, northward recirculation and independent split bands as targets. Geographic eastward maxima do not independently validate named-current/front/branch membership. The14C-at150m frontal criterion and3000m dynamic-height reference are not current depth boundaries; no thermal gate is used.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial South Australian shelf-edge reach135.5–142.5E under RidgwayCondie2004 mainly austral-winter naming convention. Exclude Leeuwin flow west of eastern Bight, Zeehan off Tasmania, gulf outflows and summer westward reversal as target identities. January and July eastward component outcomes remain separate; no sign flip or forced winter continuity. Shallow shelf exclusion and offshore eddy/recirculation contamination are explicit limitations. Fixed eastward component is not local along-slope flow or an independently identified warm-saline core.
